title: Unified Config
description: DESIGN-stage artifact. Output of config-unifier. Declares the shared configuration plus any per-condition divergences from it. Every divergence must have a non-empty justification; validate_config.py raises ValueError when a divergence has an empty or missing justification.

from_protocol_ref.description: Reference to the protocol_spec or data_protocol this config was built from

shared_config.description: Configuration keys shared identically across all conditions (the canonical baseline config)

conditions.description: Per-condition configuration entries, including divergences from shared_config

divergences.description: Keys where this condition differs from shared_config. Each MUST have a non-empty justification.

key.description: Config key that diverges from shared_config

value.description: The per-condition value for this key

justification.description: Non-empty reason why this condition diverges on this key
